page.layout: One page of running text in a single main column; in the left margin a column of marginal notes ("Forma prima," and "Secunda.") beside the text; the page number and running head at the top of the scan.

p.i: est moveri & pati: movere autem & operari est forma.
Forma itaque est activum principium. Unde posita forma corporis Physici ponuntur tria, Essentia corporis, distinctio ejus, & operatio ejus.
4. Forma proinde in corpore Physico est principium distinguens ab aliis primario & essentialiter.
5. Ut a Materia quantitas emanat: ita a forma corporis termini quantitatis prascribuntur.

main_text.p: Forma item prima est aut secunda.
Forma prima.Prima Physica forma est, propria primae materiae, & ordine reliquas omnes antecedit.
Secunda.Secunda est, quae primam sequitur, quocunque in gradu: estque materiae secundae propria.

p.i: Haec aut educitur ex materia, vel inducitur in materiam.
Haec naturaliter non unitur materiae, nisi recte dispositae & praeparatae.

main_text.head: CAPUT TERTIUM. DE MOTU ET QVIETE.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a continuation from the previous page and is set in italic. The left margin notes "Forma prima" and "Secunda" are the marginal side-headings. Heading set in capitals with a large initial Q in QVIETE; the chapter title is split over two lines ("DE MOTU ET QVI-" / "ETE."). The printed word "Adhuc" at the foot is a catchword. Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible across the text and was not transcribed.
